descriptions.w3d_d30e_voice_start_801e5b80: Starts a voice from a source: refuses if the source's stream is unusable, there are no channels or it is already playing; takes the id from source virtual slot 16, runs stream slots 23 to 25, and unless the stream is open or the voice active, claims a free entry of the 16-channel table at 0x8045dbc8 for each stream channel, sets it up through 0x802f51e4 and 0x802f5568 with a lazily allocated 96-byte buffer and the 0x801e59b4 callback. On failure it releases through stream slot 21 and returns 0. Names are inferred.
